div.div:
Non-negotiable rules
· Policies are additive — any allow opens, everything else denies
· BOTH ends needed: egress at caller + ingress at callee
· Policy ports = POD ports (8080), not Service port (80) — DNAT first
· default-deny egress kills DNS, istiod:15012, log shipping, WI metadata
